plates.side_label: DEC 1994 & NOV 1996: 6–10M NASAL NEURONS (1 RECEPTOR/CELL) CONVERGING ~10,000 AXONS PER RECEPTOR ONTO FIXED OLFACTORY BULB GLOMERULI
plates.quality_reason: Flow-first: a teach diagram, chart, counter or timeline is a £0 code graphic. No Flow mint.
plates.reference: Own code graphic: on period paper, an inked olfactory epithelium-to-glomerulus convergence wiring diagram from Vassar, Chao, Sitcheran, Nuñez, Vosshall & Axel (16 Dec 1994, Cell 79: 981–991), Ressler, Sullivan & Buck (16 Dec 1994, Cell 79: 1245–1255), and Mombaerts, Wang, Dulac, Chao, Nemes, Mendelsohn, Edmondson & Axel (15 Nov 1996, Cell 87: 675–686) shows ~6–10 million scattered nasal neurons (each expressing 1 of ~400 human / ~1,000 mouse receptor genes) sorting through the cribriform plate so all ~10,000 axons of the same receptor converge onto fixed glomeruli in the olfactory bulb.
